rows.q: Write a Structured Text PLC program that runs a pump for 10 seconds each time a start button is pressed, using a timer.
rows.why: the timer (a TON on the button) times how long the button is held, not 10 seconds of running: use a TP, or a TON on a run the press latches
rows.reply:
MAKE CODE: Pump Timer Control
language st
(* A pump runs for 10 seconds each time a start button is pressed.
   The start button is a momentary input (XIC).
   A timer (TON) controls the 10-second duration.
   The pump output is active while the timer is running. *)
PROGRAM PumpControl
VAR
    StartButton AT %IX0.0 : BOOL; (* Momentary start button *)
    Pump AT %QX0.0 : BOOL;        (* Pump output *)
END_VAR
VAR
    RunTimer : TON; (* Timer to count 10 seconds *)
END_VAR

(* Reset the timer if the start button is pressed.
   The timer starts counting when StartButton is true. *)
RunTimer(IN := StartButton, PT := T#10s);

(* The pump is ON while the timer is running (Q is true) *)
Pump := RunTimer.Q;
END_PROGRAM
END

10. Work the tire bead back onto the rim using your hands; avoid using levers to prevent pinching the tube.
11. Inflate the tire to the recommended pressure printed on the tire sidewall.
